verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a payments and fleet-management platform, but the evidence never documents a capability to act on many items in a single operation. Locations and zones only organize multiple readers. Reader registration and Dashboard refunds are described as one item at a time, and the MCP server and CLI are general tooling with no bulk semantics shown.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
